articles.title: AUKUS is falling apart before our eyes. The government and alliance shills are silent
articles.summary: The AUKUS defence pact, Australia's largest-ever defence program under the Albanese government, is notably shrouded in secrecy. Despite its scale, detailed information is reportedly not being released by Australian agencies, raising transparency concerns. This lack of official communication about the multi-billion dollar initiative poses challenges for public understanding and oversight.
